title: The One Under the Stairs
subtitle: 球棒与击球 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 球棒与击球（文学艺术与体育·体育器材）
meta: 主题语境：球棒与击球（文学艺术与体育·体育器材）　|　核心词汇：bat　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my uncle made ① a bat out of a broken chair leg and was banned from the yard for eleven years, and my grandmother said the making was the whole of the crime. The ② bat, meaning the thing in his hands and not the animal, was confiscated in June and returned in March; a bat, he said, is the only tool that is illegal only where it is used.

Every ③ bat in that house was a piece of something else, and the ④ bat under the stairs, meaning the real one bought in 1961 and not either of those, was the only one he was ever allowed to keep. A bat, my mother said, is nine parts wood and one part permission; my uncle said the permission is the part that expires.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ bat was the whole of the evening, meaning the creature and not the wood. The ⑥ bat, meaning the animal and not any of that, is the only thing in a sky that everybody watches and nobody can follow; a bat, she said, is either something you hit with or the only creature that is blamed for the dark. He said the dark was never its fault.

By 1969 the ⑦ bat had become a word in an argument about the window, and the window had become an argument about the yard. The ⑧ bat of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in May, was eleven years of bans and one returned bat; a bat, he said, is either the thing under the stairs or the reason you learned to aim. She said the aiming was the part nobody taught him.

The ⑨ bat I remember is the one under the stairs, which was still there in 1974 and was never used again. A ⑩ bat, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only object that improves by being banned; every bat, she said, is an evening that has agreed to look like a tool. He said the tool was never the problem.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 球棒（指他手里那个东西，与动物相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a bat 做一根球棒
D. n. 球棒（指屋里每一根）
E. n. 球棒（指楼梯下那一根）
G. n. 蝙蝠（抽象：那种动物）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bat out of a broken chair leg
The bat, meaning the thing in his hands and not the animal
bat was the whole of the evening
the bat had become a word in an argument about the window
The bat of the whole thing
A bat, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: make a bat 意为“做一根球棒”，1958 年叔叔用一条断掉的椅子腿做了一根球棒。
bat 意为“球棒”，指他手里那个东西而不是那只动物，它六月被没收，三月归还。
bat 指屋里每一根球棒，那屋里每一根都是别的东西改的。
bat 指楼梯下那一根（1961 年买的那根真的），是唯一允许他留着的。
bat 意为“蝙蝠”，姑姑说 bat 就是那个傍晚的全部，指的是那只动物而不是木头。
bat 为抽象用法，指那种动物，是天上人人都盯着看、却没人跟得上的东西。
bat 意为“球棒”，到 1969 年这个 bat 成了一场关于窗户的争吵里的一个词。
bat 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，叔叔五月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一年的禁令和一根归还的球棒。
bat 意为“球棒”，我记得的是楼梯下那一根，1974 年还在，只是再没被用过。
bat 为抽象总称，祖母说球棒是唯一会因为被禁止而变好的物件。
